answer: Census roll-call bond: the registry calls each live name on the yarrow roll; silence loses standing. At the velvet hour the census opens. Each identity answers with one signed pulse to a random question and locks a 70-credit bond. An auditor samples the roll; a missing or copied pulse burns the bond. First 45, k-th 45+5(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 2,542,500, lock 70,000, vs a 40,000 pool. A rented pulse bears another key; honest identities pay 45 once.
